source_notes: FSU 'Bilbao Knutsen' (2004-built LNG carrier, 138,000 m3, converted to floating storage unit by HD Hyundai Marine Solution) arrived at Puerto Cortés in September 2025 to serve as the storage backbone for this terminal. Vessel name corroborated by three independent non-GEM outlets: LNG Prime (24 Sep 2025), PortNews, and Baird Maritime. Note this is an FSU (storage only), not a regas-equipped FSRU.

Centrica's 15-year SPA with Exodus (announced Nov 2025) is expected to commence in 2026, with ~6 LNG cargoes/year delivered ship-to-ship into the FSU at Puerto Cortés. 2026 commencement corroborated by two independent non-GEM outlets (LNG Prime; Pipeline & Gas Journal). Start year is implied from the supply-contract commencement, not a regulator-confirmed COD — hence yellow. No firm month available.
